36:0.en: 「$$アマタ$$, let me hear your melody.」

36:35.en: 「Now our sounds will play a new song!」

36:188.en: 「$$アマタ・ソラ$$, I expect great things.」

36:221.en: 「Whenever you are. Go, $$アマタ・ソラ$$.」

36:293.en: 「Skip the report. Focus on the fight.」

36:336.en: 「$$アマタ・ソラ$$! This is the real test!」

36:375.en: 「$$アマタ・ソラ$$! Your wings are...」

alternatives: Time to repay what I owe, Mikage!

36:611.en: 「Well done! I respect you now, $$アマタ$$!」

36:654.en: 「What are you doing? Let me lead!」

alternatives: Damn it! How dare you pull that!

36:1099.en: 「W-we'll be done for at this rate...!」

36:1342.en: 「I've got to do my part too!」

36:1367.en: 「There are things even I can do!」

36:1429.en: 「The enemy's right in front of me!」

36:1506.en: 「If I can draw out $$アクエリオン$$'s power!」

36:1619.en: 「I can feel everyone! I can do this!」

36:1886.en: 「$$ゼシカ$$, lend me your power too!」

36:2015.en: 「All right! Let's do this, $$アンディ$$!」

36:2046.en: 「I'm fine, $$アンディ$$! I can do this!」

36:2081.en: 「I-I don't get it, but I'll try!」

36:2122.en: 「$$シュレード$$! Lend me your power!」

36:2318.en: 「$$ユノハ$$! Unite your power with ours!」

36:2376.en: 「I-I'll just give it all I've got!」

36:2874.en: 「If we can land one more blow...!」

36:2940.en: 「Defeat that one, and the war ends!」

36:3020.en: 「I'll sever the root of this evil!」

36:3110.en: 「Not $$アポロ$$ or $$ポロン$$!\nI'm $$アマタ・ソラ$$!」

36:3167.en: 「$$アクエリオン$$ won't lose in raw power...!」

36:3292.en: 「Their speed can fool me and beat me!」

36:3335.en: 「I'll take them on with my wings!」

36:3360.en: 「Aerial foe? Then I'll use my wings!」

36:3481.en: 「It's so small, I can barely aim...!」

36:3659.en: 「No pilot means I can go all out!」

36:3731.en: 「It's a monster...! I'll go all out!」

36:3819.en: 「If words fail, we'll have to fight!」

36:3899.en: 「I won't lose to a future of despair!」

36:3985.en: 「Aliens won't do as they please here!」

36:4022.en: 「Aim at Earth and you face me!」

36:4311.en: 「I won't let you have your way here!」

36:4428.en: 「Our feelings and love will beat you!」

36:4469.en: 「I'll take back the freedom\nand peace you stole!」

36:4520.en: 「I won't let you have your way\nwith Earth anymore!」

36:4571.en: 「Just because you have a $$スフィア$$...!」

36:4614.en: 「Even $$スフィア$$ power won't beat me...!」

36:4655.en: 「We'll cut the past that binds you!」

36:4698.en: 「Whatever your reasons,\nI won't accept what you've done!」

36:4806.en: 「I'll soar beyond the fate\nyou're forcing on us!」

36:5162.en: 「If I can land a direct hit!」

36:5181.en: 「If they're at range, I'll use this!」
alternatives: If you want distance, take this!

36:5210.en: 「If I draw them into close combat!」
alternatives: I'll bring this into close combat!

36:5395.en: 「Run all you want! This'll reach you!」

36:6040.en: 「We'll fly as far as we can!」

36:6377.en: 「If I don't fight, they'll get me!」

36:6450.en: 「I'll take it from here! Fall back!」

36:6510.en: 「I'll back up the $$神話型アクエリオン$$!」

36:6560.en: 「I can at least serve as your shield!」
alternatives: I can at least be your shield...!

36:6672.en: 「I'll shield the $$神話型アクエリオン$$!」

alternatives: I'll force this into a one-on-one!

36:6928.en: 「We'll be beaten down at this rate!」

36:7306.en: 「I can do this if I stay calm!」

36:7716.en: 「An attack like that won't hit me!」

36:7883.en: 「We've got a barrier, so we're fine!」

36:7943.en: 「Whoa! I built up too much momentum!」

36:8179.en: 「That won't stop me as I am now!」

36:8450.en: 「Sorry, $$モロイ$$! I let my guard down!」

36:8688.en: 「No need! I'm the Head right now!」

36:8910.en: 「If the engine's intact, I can fight!」

36:9139.en: 「A direct hit! They read our moves!」

36:9359.en: 「It's okay, $$ユノハ$$! I'll find a way!」

36:9453.en: 「Yes! I'll give it all I've got!」

36:9484.en: 「$$アクエリオン$$ always turns it around!」

36:9568.en: 「Whoa! Is this as far as we go!?」

36:9634.en: 「Even $$アクエリオン$$ can't take any more!」

36:9869.en: 「Not yet! My wings aren't broken yet!」

36:10074.en: 「Damn it! I refuse to give up!!」

36:10671.en: 「$$ミコノ$$ is wrong! How can you connect with anything all alone!?」

36:10754.en: 「I level every unit evenly in SRW.」

36:11150.en: 「Sorry, $$ゼシカ$$. Just $$ミコノ$$ and me.」

36:11207.en: 「Great work! Rest up till next time.」

36:11353.en: 「I can do it too if I try!」

36:11671.en: 「$$アマタ$$, $$ゼシカ$$! Focus your minds!」

36:11912.en: 「Oh! Now I'm really getting fired up!」

36:11953.en: 「$$アマタ$$! Show me how cool you can be!」

36:12099.en: 「Eek! I still\nhave lots left to do!」

36:12261.en: 「Oh, look at you two showing off...」

36:12596.en: 「If this power can forge the future!」

36:12635.en: 「$$アマタ$$! I've read the enemy's moves!」

36:12674.en: 「$$アマタ$$! Take $$ユノハ$$'s power and mine!」

36:12742.en: 「$$アマタ$$, your reactions are too slow!」

36:12882.en: 「$$アマタ$$! Their weak point is there!」

36:13410.en: 「I'm fine! Focus on the fight, $$アマタ$$!」

36:13552.en: 「$$アマタ$$! Turn my feelings into power!」

36:13957.en: 「I-I'm shy, but I'll do my best!」
